title: Swarming Assay for High Number of Animals
author: Serena Ding
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uagesbw

steps.title: Synchronize Animal Population
steps.instruction: Bleach synchronize animals across 3 large plates (90mm), ensuring a high presence of gravid hermaphrodites.

substeps.instruction: Leave plates on a rotator at 20 °C until use.

steps.title: Perform Initial Overnight Imaging
steps.instruction: Place the plate inside the tracker with an appropriate field of view, positioning the worm front at the edge of the illuminated circular field so they sweep over the field of view.

steps.title: Transfer Worms to Imaging Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer ~160 uL of worms onto an imaging plate (90 mm plate pre-seeded with undiluted OP50 at least one day prior) using a glass pipette.

substeps.instruction: Minimize the amount of liquid carried to avoid dispersing bacteria on the imaging plate.

steps.title: Configure Imaging Software and Hardware
steps.instruction: Set the frame rate to 0.1 Hz using the CommonVision control box and initialize the experiment in Gecko.

substeps.instruction: Set recording to fixed duration (60 minute recording, repeat 15 times).

steps.title: Re-feed and Incubate Worms
steps.instruction: Re-feed worms onto 3-4 large plates (90mm) pre-seeded with undiluted OP50 using a glass pipette.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the lawn is uniform or contains gaps depending on experimental needs.

steps.title: Pool and Wash Animals
steps.instruction: Pool animals together from 3 large plates (90mm) and wash them in M9.

substeps.instruction: Aspire as much supernatant as possible after the final wash.
